summary:
Data Analyst / Power BI Developer with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise-grade business intelligence, advanced
analytics, and data visualization solutions. Proven expertise in designing high-impact Power BI dashboards, developing
complex DAX-driven analytical models, and transforming large-scale datasets into actionable business insights. Strong
background in SQL optimization, data modeling, AI-assisted analytics, and reporting automation, with a
demonstrated ability to identify data inconsistencies, improve data quality, and optimize reporting performance. Adaptive
to working with cross-functional stakeholders to build scalable, intuitive, and business-centric analytical solutions that drive
operational efficiency and strategic decision-making.

bullets: Spearheaded the design and development of enterprise-scale Power BI dashboards and analytical reporting solutions, enabling leadership teams to monitor operational, financial, and business KPIs in real time.

Delivered highly interactive and mobile-responsive Power BI reporting solutions, improving accessibility, user adoption, and decision-making efficiency across departments. Engineered advanced DAX calculations, time intelligence measures, and KPI frameworks to support complex analytical requirements and executive-level reporting.

Designed scalable data models, semantic layers, and optimized schema relationships, ensuring high-performance analytics and reporting accuracy. Developed and optimized complex SQL queries using joins, CTEs, window functions, and query tuning techniques to support high-volume data processing and transformation.

Conducted in-depth analysis of data discrepancies, anomalies, and reporting inconsistencies, identifying root causes and implementing corrective data quality solutions. Collaborated closely with business stakeholders, analysts, and engineering teams to align reporting outputs with business logic, governance standards, and strategic objectives.

Leveraged Generative AI and Microsoft Fabric AI capabilities to automate reporting workflows, generate intelligent insights, and improve analytical productivity. Developed AI-driven narrative summaries and contextual analytical insights, enhancing business users’ ability to interpret dashboard outputs effectively.
Optimized report performance through data model refinement, DAX optimization, and query performance engineering, significantly reducing dashboard load times.
Established documentation standards for metric definitions, transformation logic, reporting assumptions, and governance practices, improving transparency and maintainability.
Utilized Snowflake’s SQL capabilities to automate ELT processes, manage data ingestion, and execute scheduled data loads to support comprehensive analysis.
Integrated and transformed data from sources such as Snowflake, SQL Server, Excel, REST APIs, and Azure, ensuring comprehensive data coverage and consistency.

Built scalable automation solutions using Power Automate, Power Apps, and custom scripting (Python, SQL, Power Query) to orchestrate end-to-end business workflows, enhance data accuracy, and integrate BI outputs with Microsoft 365 and Azure services.
